_comment: English seed library for the dream noise imagery pool (工单 D-4 六期; loaded when OMBRE_LANG=en, the zh file noise_imagery.json is untouched). Same shape as the zh file: anchors + generated. Rules per line: one concrete noun or everyday scene plus exactly one thing that is wrong with it, at most 9 words; no abstract words (time/fate/loneliness/eternity/memory/soul), no similes (like/as if/as though), no poetic register, no horror clichés (blood/ghost/corpse), nothing tied to real memories. Runtime monthly growth appends to <buckets_dir>/dream/imagery_extra_en.json, never to this file.
anchors: a door that opens downward
rain that smells of iron
a staircase missing one step
a fish tank full of keys
an orange that is empty when peeled
a doorbell pressed many times and nobody answers
an umbrella that never gets wet in a storm
a keyboard where every key says the same letter
an elevator button that glows before you press it
a mailbox stuffed with unopened envelopes addressed to strangers
a lamp that gets darker the longer it burns
a kettle that whistles a different note each day
a phone ringing with no number on the screen
a photograph where everyone is facing away
a newspaper printed entirely in tomorrow's date
a ladder that ends at a blank wall
a window painted shut from the inside
a faucet that drips upward into the sink
a single shoe left in an empty hallway
a glove with six fingers
a toaster that makes bread colder
an escalator that keeps climbing after you step off
a vending machine that gives change before you pay
a parking meter counting backward
a wallet full of coins from no country
a backpack heavier empty than full
sunglasses that make the room brighter
a bathtub that fills from the drain
a light switch with a third position
a drawer deeper on the inside than the outside
a candle burning without losing height
a coin that always lands on its edge
generated: a bicycle pedaling backward on its own
a stapler that binds pages nobody wrote
a thermostat set to a temperature with no number
a printer that only prints blank pages with weight
a streetlamp that flickers only when no one looks
a remote control that changes channels nobody is watching
a calculator that gives a different answer each morning
a curtain that moves in a sealed room
a rug whose pattern shifts when unwatched
a shower head that sprays sand
a refrigerator magnet holding up nothing
a padlock that turns both ways at once
a rusty hinge that creaks only when nothing moves
a small closet with a cavernous echo
a bookshelf where every spine is blank
a matchbox that rattles but holds no matches
a lock that opens to any hand
a chain-link fence with no beginning or end
a turnstile that spins backward when you pass through
a park bench bolted to the ceiling
a swing moving with nobody pushing it
a seesaw balanced with one seat empty
a fountain that pours dust instead of water
a statue that changes pose overnight
a bell that rings without being touched
a silent whistle that still hurts the ears
a drum that beats when the room is quiet
a typewriter that finishes words before you start typing
